what: Calculate Transition Matrix from Two-Cell Correlation — calculate_transition_matrix
title: Calculate Transition Matrix from Two-Cell Correlation — calculate_transition_matrix
text: function calculates cell transition matrices based two-cell correlation functions C(u). first computes frequency cell type (using single-leaf nodes), builds standardized cell type combination avoid duplicate counts. Using node pair depth data selected depth measure (e.g., "lca_normalized_height" "lca_depth"), function computes correlation frequencies depth. depth (maximum threshold fi_depth), corresponding transition matrix computed using eigenvalue decomposition, eigenvalues adjusted according depth. Finally, average transition matrix depths used initial guess optimization procedure (via L-BFGS-B method) derive optimal transition matrix.

title: Calculate Transition Matrix from Two-Cell Correlation — calculate_transition_matrix
code: calculate_transition_matrix(   node_pair_depth,   node_info,   sel_u,   use_cores,   fi_depth,   bound_matrix,   cell_type_list )

title: Get Optimal Transition Matrix — get_optimal_transition_matrix
text: Compute optimal cell transition matrix integrating node-pair depth information per-cell annotations. function: (1) filters terminal (single-leaf) cells selected cell types, (2) calls calculate_transition_matrix() infer best transition matrix structural constraints, (3) flattens matrix long data frame start/end cell-type pairs normalized transition strengths, (4) labels results evaluated depth cutoff. version Windows-safe: internal parallelism automatically coerced single-core Windows vignette building (pkgdown) fail 'mc.cores' > 1 supported Windows.

title: Get Optimal Transition Matrix — get_optimal_transition_matrix
code: get_optimal_transition_matrix(   node_pair_depth,   cell_info,   Sel_u,   fi_depth,   Bound_Matrix,   cell_type_list,   mc.cores = parallel::detectCores() )

title: Get Optimal Transition Matrix — get_optimal_transition_matrix
text: node_pair_depth data frame containing node pair depth information (e.g. calculate_lca_depths()). cell_info data frame per-cell info; must contain least cellNum celltype. rows cellNum == 1 retained (terminal leaves), filtered provided cell_type_list. Sel_u Character string choosing depth/height measure use node_pair_depth (e.g. "lca_normalized_height"). fi_depth Numeric. Depth cutoff / threshold passed calculate_transition_matrix(). Bound_Matrix Numeric matrix encoding constraints (e.g. irreversible transitions). Diagonal/upper-triangular structure often encodes prior directionality. cell_type_list Character vector cell types interest, order defines transition structure. mc.cores Integer. Desired parallel cores. Windows silently coerced 1. non-Windows coerced least 1.

title: Get Optimal Transition Matrix — get_optimal_transition_matrix
text: list : optimal_matrix: inferred optimal transition matrix (cell type x cell type). optimal_norm_df_dataframe: long-form data frame columns type_combined_new, start_cell, end_cell, norm_optimal_T, depth ("d_<fi_depth>").
